description: This file declares version-related constants, functions for retrieving user agent strings, and system information for a Git repository; it appears to be a header file defining interfaces related to versioning and system info.

methods.name: git_user_agent
methods.description: Returns a pointer to a string containing the user agent.

methods.name: git_user_agent_sanitized
methods.description: Returns a sanitized version of the user agent string.

methods.name: get_uname_info
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve system information using uname(2), returning 0 on success or -1 on failure and filling a buffer with system info or error message.
